purpose: Fresh, never-inspected scenarios for evaluating the FROZEN MG-013 PPO checkpoint (results/approved/mg013_ppo_checkpoint.mat, SHA-256 5a0da1715a1c2f7044a3b954d8cdf5e6d234731a2f4619d82cb3ea87e875b8ad) against the MG-005 fixed grid. No training, checkpoint selection, threshold or reward change is permitted in MG-019, so these scenarios are an untouched holdout for the frozen policy.

environment.generator: matlab/experiments/mg013ScenarioConfig.m (10x10 m, 2 m cells, 0-2 seeded rectangular no-fly zones clear of the SW start cell, altitude 2 m, 2 m/s, dt 0.1 s)
environment.object_counts: target_count = 1 + mod(seed,2); clutter_count = mod(seed,3) (MG-019 adds synthetic objects for exploratory detection; geometry/no-fly zones are unchanged by counts)
environment.budget: mineguard.rl.defaultEnvConfig: D_max 60 m, T_max 30 s, 50 decisions, start cell 1 (SW), shared by both planners
environment.detector: MG014-RUNLOCK-1 frozen model (fitted for 2 m altitude), weighted / single_valid, threshold 2; evaluation cell = 2 m MG-005 grid

primary_endpoints: navigation: coverage fraction, unique visited legal cells, distance, simulated time, coverage per metre and per second, invalid actions, revisits, termination reason, completion; paired delta = PPO - GRID on grid-feasible scenarios; grid-infeasible scenarios reported separately and never scored as PPO wins
secondary_endpoints: exploratory detection: events, TP/FP/TN/FN, precision, recall, F1, FPR, invalid sensor fractions, localization error. Different routes sample different positions, so sensor noise realisations differ; detection differences are NOT evidence of planner superiority.

replication_set.label: REPLICATION of MG-013 TEST (already inspected in MG-013; not a fresh holdout)

excluded: MG-014 GF-001..GF-030 (20x20 m, 100 cells): incompatible with the 25-action policy and GF-025..030 already opened in MG-015. Not used.
rules: Run every listed scenario once with both planners; never drop or replace a scenario after seeing results.
Do not modify the checkpoint, reward, budget, sensors, detector model or thresholds.
Report incomplete/failed PPO missions and infeasible grid routes explicitly.
